title: Reporting Verification
description: Evidence that a materialization represents the intended reporting revision. Logical content digests are only canonical when canonicalization_id identifies the exact row ordering, value encoding, null, and schema rules. Physical object checksums and native commit evidence are method-specific and are not interchangeable with a logical digest.

verified_at.description: When the producer completed verification through the claimed consumer/destination path.

verification_path.description: Path on which verification succeeded. dataset_share readiness requires representative_consumer; delivered warehouse state requires destination.

row_count.description: Verified row count. Zero explicitly distinguishes an empty committed revision from a missing revision.

canonicalization_id.description: Versioned AdCP or reporting-profile canonicalization rules used to produce the digest.

physical_checksums.description: Method-specific byte/object checksums. Different encodings of the same logical revision normally have different values.
